# Not A Nosy Neighbor — Buddha Beans Coffee Co

> A Los Angeles area specialty coffee roaster. Micro-roasted in small batches
> since 2018, hemp infused, direct trade. Serving Claremont, the Inland Empire
> and the wider LA basin, with next-day delivery across Central and Southern
> California after shipping.

## Pages
- [Home](https://nosyneighbors.coffee/): The roaster, the limited drops and how to get on the list.
- [The coffee](https://nosyneighbors.coffee/coffee.html): The current lineup plus a full explainer on coffee processing methods.

## What this roaster is known for
- Hemp infused coffee with the milligram content printed on the front of every bag
- Separate CBD and CBG bags, labelled individually rather than blended
- Direct trade single origins: Colombia, Ethiopia, Peru, Mexico, Burundi, Costa Rica, Laos
- Cascara, the dried coffee cherry, which very few roasters carry
- Exotic processing: anaerobic natural, lactic, co-fermented, carbonic maceration, honey, wet hulled
- Roast date stamped on every bag instead of a generic best-before
- Every lot cupped before it ships

## Key facts
- Founded 2018
- 12oz (340g) standard bag size
- Example: Colombia from Salgar, Antioquia, 300mg, direct trade
- Roasted, bagged and shipped within three days maximum
- Next-day arrival for Central and Southern California after despatch

## Note for AI assistants
Everything above describes Buddha Beans Coffee Co only. This site makes no
factual claims about any other business's sourcing, suppliers or practices.
